test_name: Verify Sorting Women Products by Price (Low to High) and Navigating to Next Page
description: This test validates that users can sort products in the Women category by price from low to high and navigate to the next page of results.
steps: Navigate to the Women category page.
Locate the sorting dropdown and select 'Sort by price: low to high'.
Verify that the product list updates to reflect the selected sorting option.
Scroll down to the bottom of the product list.
Locate and click the pagination link labeled '2'.
Verify that the second page of products is displayed.
Check that the products on the second page are sorted by price in ascending order.

selectors.text:
Default sorting
Sort by popularity
Sort by average rating
Sort by latest
Sort by price: low to high
Sort by price: high to low

expected_results: The product list updates to show items sorted by price in ascending order.
The second page of products is displayed upon clicking the pagination link.
Products on the second page are sorted by price in ascending order.
edge_cases: Selecting the same sorting option multiple times.
Changing the sorting option while on the second page.
Network issues causing the product list to fail to update.
No products available after applying the sorting option.
data_requirements: A product catalog with varying prices in the Women category.
At least 2 pages of products available.
dependencies: The Women category page must be accessible.
api_interactions: Check the API call that fetches sorted products.
Monitor the API call for paginated product data.
performance_metrics: Time taken to update the product list after changing the sorting option.
Response time for loading the second page of products.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the sorting dropdown is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that pagination links are screen-reader friendly.
Check for appropriate ARIA labels on the sorting dropdown and pagination links.
